shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && rg -n \"data grid|table|@gravity-ui/table\" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && sed -n '1,220p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,160p' src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; rg -n \"## Table|withTableSorting|withTableSelection|Pagination\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -80; node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version\"; rg -n \"withTableSorting|withTableSelection|Pagination|Table\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/typings node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table Pagination Checkbox; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'Table|README.md|docs/INDEX' | head -80; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60; rg -n \"withTableSorting|withTableSelection\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--g-color-(base|text)-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f2- | sort -u | rg 'positive|warning|brand|selection|generic|secondary|hint' | head -100; npm run build"
